result.summary: Several visual problems: a broken restaurant image, truncated restaurant names and category chips, and a promo card cut off at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid image or provide a proper fallback so the card does not appear empty.

issues.description: The last restaurant name in the Fastest near you row is clipped ("Trattoria Piccol").
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, smaller type, or more horizontal space so full names remain readable.

issues.description: The category chips row is cut off on the right, so later categories are only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade, peek of the next chip, or ensure horizontal scroll is obvious so users know more filters exist.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is cropped by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or scroll inset so the last card is fully visible above the navigation bar.
